newsitem.title: ITALY: Gemina details bourse HPI share assessment.
newsitem.headline: Gemina details bourse HPI share assessment.

text.p: The Italian stock market has evaluated ordinary shares in new holding company HPI at 1,050 lire and savings shares at 1,000 lire, a statement from financial holding company Gemina said.
HPI, whose full name is Holding di Partecipazioni Industriali SpA, is the company in which Gemina plans to spin off its industrial operations.
Gemina is not bound by the stock market evaluation.
Gemina is offering 2.57 billion ordinary shares and 112.9 million non convertible savings shares.
The stock market council also estimated HPI's total value at 2.815 trillion lire.

Gemina said the prospectus for the spin-off would be passed on to stock market regulator Consob in the coming week with the aim of requesting HPI ordinary, savings shares and warrants on ordinary shares be allowed to list on the bourse.
Gemina will be left with a clutch of financial assets after the spin off is complete. (( --Milan bureau +392 66129507 ))
